arithmetic: All certificate decisions are exact rational arithmetic.

model.spectrum: 1 once; 1/2 twice; 1/4 once; 2^(-n) once for every n>=4

scenarios.name: exact_infinite_tail
scenarios.detail: Exact rational moments, including the complete geometric tail.

scenarios.name: rounded_moment_enclosures
scenarios.detail: Moments rounded to 36 decimal places with exact half-unit bounds.

scenarios.name: perturbed_centers
scenarios.detail: Centers shifted by signed 10^-20; the rounded moments are unchanged.

scenarios.name: omitted_cluster_negative_control
scenarios.detail: The center 1/2, which has multiplicity two, is deliberately omitted.

scenarios.name: coarse_precision_negative_control
scenarios.detail: Valid moment enclosures rounded to only 16 decimal places.
